card.name: Second digit in dose-table numbers
card.fires_on: The last digit of a two-digit number in dose or schedule tables, mostly in rows that count up (such as 21, 41) with units and mcg or mg beside them. It also fires weakly on the word 'information' after 'administration'.

modes.label: Counting dose table
modes.description: Final digit of a row number in a unit-to-dose conversion table that counts up by one.
modes.example: 19 19 units 6.3 mcg 20 20 units 6.7 mcg 21 2<<1>> units 7 mcg 22

modes.label: Percent or dose in regimen table
modes.description: Final digit of a number such as 40 in a regimen or heart-function table.

modes.label: Word after administration
modes.description: The word 'information' after 'refer to ... for administration'.
modes.example: refer to BCG Prescribing Information for administration<< information>>. Combination Regimens: Order of Administration
